description: One entity per daemon holding a config map (Phase 1 shape for ateles#642). Keys are logical names (e.g. sse_subscription_id); values are CONFIG only — secret values never stored. Register with: neotoma schemas register daemon_configuration --fields @docs/schemas/daemon_configuration.json --activate

daemon_name.description: Short daemon identity matching handler_name / SSE client name (e.g. apis, neotoma-agent). Canonical lookup key for config_resolver._fetch_from_neotoma.

config.description: Map of logical config keys to string values. Never holds secret values — only CONFIG-class facts.

set_by.description: Agent or operator identity that authored this entity.

notes.description: Free-text drift/history notes (same role as deployment_configuration.gotchas).
